source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned change replaces protocol-specific Yahoo host entries with yahoo.com and adds att.net, both mapped to login.yahoo.com with mail-w. Its existing lookup removes complete leftmost hostname labels, so mail subdomains reach the parent-domain mapping. The accepted implementation retains these keys with wider scopes, lowercase built-in lookup and later extension/type rules; those are separate phases. Mail and outgoing initialization pass the configured server hostname and username. Current OAuth object reuse checks login origin, authorization endpoint, username and required-scope containment. The checked internal request-window start path independently selects private/non-private mode from the global mailnews.oauth.usePrivateBrowser preference; these paths do not select a per-user browser container. Generic subdomain assertions and ATT/Yahoo exchange-rejection assertions are direct source evidence, not live ATT mail authentication or cookie-isolation tests. No login or test ran.
title: ATT OAuth host support reuses Yahoo lookup without adding browser isolation
